app.name: MACROBANDIT
app.subtitle: 100% Free. 100% Ad-Free. For Real Results.
app.description: No annoying diet gurus, no social media feed, and absolutely no ad banners slowing you down while logging. Macrobandit is the lean, lightning-fast macro counter for athletes who want their numbers dialed in to the gram. Completely free, no hidden premium subscriptions.
app.videoSubtitle: Explained in 2 minutes — from your first scan to your monthly goal.
app.feature1Text: Forget apps that hit you with 30-second ad videos before every scanned food. Macrobandit is and always will be completely ad-free. Open it, log it, done. Your discipline doesn't need interruptions.
app.feature2Text: Barcode scanner, weekly overview, gram-precise analytics — no paywall here. All features are fully available from day one. No in-app purchases, no 'Pro' versions.
app.feature3Text: Because the app is free, we still don't sell your data. Optimized as a Progressive Web App (PWA), your tracker runs super fast, stores your values securely and belongs 100% to you.
app.pwaSubtitle: No App Store required. Save the tracker to your home screen in seconds.
app.pwaIosStep1: Open macrobandit.at in the Safari browser.
app.pwaIosStep2: Tap the share icon at the bottom (square with arrow pointing up).
app.pwaIosStep3: Scroll down and select 'Add to Home Screen'.
app.pwaAndroidStep1: Open macrobandit.at in the Chrome browser.
app.pwaAndroidStep2: Tap the three dots in the top right.
app.pwaAndroidStep3: Select 'Install App' or 'Add to Home Screen'.
app.installBannerText: Add it to your home screen – lightning-fast, offline & no app store.
app.featuresSub: Every feature is unlocked for free from the very first second.
app.featGrid1Text: Scan foods with your camera and pull in calories & macros in seconds.
app.featGrid2Text: Protein, carbs, fat & fiber – tracked and analyzed down to the gram.
app.featGrid3Text: Calculate your daily calorie needs and derive your goal automatically.
app.featGrid4Text: Keep trends, averages and your best days in view at all times.
app.featGrid5Text: No ad banners, no paywall, no premium subscriptions. All features from the start.
app.featGrid6Text: Install the tracker on your home screen – lightning-fast and usable offline.
app.howSub: From sign-up to analyzed progress in four steps.
app.howStep1Text: Sign up in 30 seconds with email and password – completely free.
app.howStep2Text: Scan the barcode, search the database or enter your values manually.
app.howStep3Text: Calories and macronutrients are automatically counted against your daily goal.
app.howStep4Text: Track weight plus weekly and monthly trends and optimize your nutrition.
app.benefitsSub: A tracker that's on your side – not on the advertisers'.
app.benefit1Text: No subscription, no hidden costs, no in-app purchases.
app.benefit2Text: No data selling, no profiling, no tracking cookies.
app.benefit3Text: A lean Progressive Web App without unnecessary bloat.
app.benefit4Text: Entries sync automatically as soon as you're back online.
app.shareText: Check out MacroBandit – the free, ad-free macro & calorie tracker!
app.sisterText: IronBandit is your ad-free workout tracker – the perfect companion to your macro tracking. Nutrition and training from one team.

Purpose of the Medium:
Macrobandit is a purely private, non-commercial and free online tool for personal documentation of macronutrients and calories for sports and fitness enthusiasts. No commercial interests are pursued.
app.legalDatenschutzContent:
The protection of your personal data is important to me. I process your data exclusively on the basis of legal provisions (GDPR, TKG).

1. What data is processed?
For the use of the core functions, the following data is stored in the database: Username (pseudonym), password (encrypted), entered food and macronutrient values, and optional body data (e.g. weight, targets).

2. Purpose of data processing
Data processing occurs exclusively to provide you with the tracker functions. No profiling takes place.

3. No advertising, no data sales
This project is 100% free and ad-free. Your data will never be sold, rented or shared for advertising purposes.

4. Camera access
The app uses access to your device's camera exclusively locally in the browser for the barcode scanner. No video data is stored on the server.

5. Local data storage (localStorage)
Authentication tokens (JWT) are stored in your browser's localStorage for login. These serve exclusively to keep you logged in and are automatically deleted upon logout. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.

6. External services
When scanning barcodes, the public Open Food Facts API (openfoodfacts.org) is used to query product data. Only the barcode is transmitted. No personal data is shared with Open Food Facts.

7. Your rights
You have the rights to access, correction, deletion and restriction. If you delete your account, all your data will be irreversibly removed.
app.legalNutzungContent:
1. Free Use "as seen"
Macrobandit is a purely private hobby project. The provision is made without any warranty for availability, accuracy of nutritional data or permanent data storage.

2. Disclaimer
— No medical advice: The calculated values do not replace medical or nutritional advice. Use is at your own risk.
— Liability for data loss: No liability is assumed for any data loss or server failures.

3. Prohibition of misuse
The use of automated scripts (bots) or attempts to manipulate the infrastructure are prohibited and will result in immediate exclusion.
